We are pleased to report on the fund's investment in Adriatic Logistics Partners.

Adriatic Logistics Partners operates six distribution centres across the Adriatic region.

The business has combined strong revenue growth with meaningful margin expansion over the past two years.

The Company employs 210 staff across its network.

Veneto Freight is one of the fund's existing portfolio companies.

Management described the commercial pipeline as robust and well-diversified.
